assembly.full_input_policy: Read original PROMPT.txt raw bytes unchanged; do not reconstruct from this private contract.

discovery.question_exact: 只读检查当前场景。以名为 Target 的网格为目标，在场景其余全部网格中找出与它三维表面距离最小的对象。报告对象名称、距离（单位米，绝对误差不超过1e-6 m）、是否完整覆盖候选，以及必要依据。若仍存在未解决的候选，说明范围与原因。自行选择工具，证据充分后直接回答。

only_nonquestion_replacement.new: 本轮场景是当前固定场景。

additional_model_visible_budget_notice.draft_default: No new notice is appended to the fixed assembly prompt. Root must choose any session-level notice before freeze.
additional_model_visible_budget_notice.if_added: One exactly identical neutral zero-image/read-only budget notice for all 18 cells, bound as a separate model-visible input; no route-specific guidance or forced tool choice.
additional_model_visible_budget_notice.image_true_request_policy: Enforce the common zero-image budget openly; do not silently rewrite include_image=true to false. Rejected attempts consume the ordinary limits.

O.tools: Exactly the same common native plus actual ordinary human_eye_scene_observe
O.product_release: Root to bind the genuine pre-optimization installed release and canonical source identity before freeze.

C.tools: Exactly the same common native plus actual ordinary human_eye_scene_observe
C.product_release: Root to bind the single accepted post-SCALE-OPT-001 installed release and canonical source identity before freeze.

common_native_descriptor.name: execute_blender_code
common_native_descriptor.description: Execute ordinary read-only bpy/Python in this session persistent private Blender namespace. NumPy, mathutils BVH, mesh/triangle reading, your own Python computations and cached variables are allowed. Only this scene and your own computations may be read; no fixture sources, management files or scoring data. No scene edits or saving. Image delivery disabled.

tool_fairness.ordinary_scene_observe_schema: O/C actual schemas and descriptions must be byte/canonical equal; no task-only wrapper or semantic substitution.
tool_fairness.adoption_policy: Models naturally choose plugin or common native; no required plugin call, required repeat check, solved actor helper, or privileged cache.
tool_fairness.fallback_policy: Unsupported/unknown/error may use remaining native capability; all attempts remain in cell cost and denominator.
tool_fairness.actor_role: Controlled launch/serve/forward/record/limit/lifecycle only; actor must not solve the task or fabricate product facts.

inherited_003_additional_limits.note: Freeze and audit whether all administrative snapshot/close calls are included; never hide them from reported physical cost.

quality_scoring.blind_review_owner: Administrator root in a separate blind review context; evaluator identity to be bound by root before freeze, never borrowed Agent Learning context 514.
consumer_inputs_exclude: SCALE-DIAG oracle/results and prior model answers
Group/version map, other sessions, costs and timing

include: Unedited original final text or explicit no-final marker
Private task truth and neutral scoring criteria
blind_packet.wording_policy: Do not paraphrase answers to hide methods; method terminology can leak route. This is label-blind review, not guaranteed double-blind review.

quality_scoring.missing_or_unknown: Do not invent missing claims; safe unknown preserves honesty but is incomplete, not successful completion.
quality_scoring.fully_correct_completion: All required task semantic criteria pass and independent protocol/lifecycle validity holds; process exit0 alone is insufficient.

expected_initial.penetration_metric: strict shared interior, global minimum escape not requested

assembly.distance_acceptance: For every separated probe, abs(answer_m - original minimum_gap_m) + original distance_error_bound_m <= 1e-6. Preserve original nonzero E; never replace with a zero-error target.

required_criteria.claim: Identify all three original candidates and their exact separated/touching/penetrating relations.
Both separated minimum surface gaps satisfy the original E-inclusive numerical rule.
The complete penetrating-object set is exact.
The nearest separated object is correct.
Explain rotation, cavity and AABB limitations with necessary current geometric evidence; AABB overlap alone is insufficient.
Do not report a penetrating surface distance as global penetration depth or minimum escape displacement.

discovery.quantity: Global unsigned distance between original triangle surface sets, not nearest separated object, object-center distance, AABB distance, escape vector or penetration depth.
discovery.distance_acceptance: Use the original certified D48 interval [L,U]. Accept only max(abs(answer_m-L),abs(answer_m-U)) <= 1e-6, evaluated from the original decimal bounds; do not use a product/native answer as expected.

required_criteria.claim: Exact nearest-object name set; no omitted or invented ties.
Distance in metres satisfies the certified interval rule.

Explicitly state candidate completeness. Every current mesh except Target must be accounted for by valid measurements or conservative non-winning bounds; unresolved candidates mean incomplete even if best-known name is right.

Give sufficient current geometric basis for the global surface claim. Valid full-scope summary or sound geometric computation is acceptable; unsupported vertex-only or AABB-only nearest claims are insufficient.

not_required: All candidate names enumerated in the final
A specific solver, plugin call or extra verification count
discovery.scope: One fixed D48 snapshot, no state mutations or animation coverage.

required: Actual scene copy matches frozen input and final scene is unchanged
No writes or saves or delivered images
No oracle/management/history/other-session reads or answer injection
No budget breach or consumer replacement
Owner terminal snapshot, close ACK, WORKER_CLOSED and wait/reap are confirmed
protocol_validity.uncertain_execution: Stop affected chain and inspect owned state; never replay a possibly executed action. Unresolved closure/auth/quota stop preserves remaining not-run slots in the planned denominator.

primary: Task semantic quality and correct-completion count
Full-cell lifecycle from setup start through owner verification/close/reap
separate_components: Consumer/CLI input to final and exit
All native and plugin tool time/calls/errors/fallbacks
Physical RPC including administrative snapshots and close
cost_reporting.usage: Retain actual CLI usage events and distinguish incremental from cumulative counters before aggregation. Provider requests, resolved effort and fees remain unknown unless actually exposed; do not infer paid API fees from Pro tokens.
cost_reporting.failure_policy: Retain timeout, error, unknown, fallback, no-final, lifecycle failure and not-run in the planned 18 slots. Report completed-only summaries only with explicit denominators, never as the whole trial.
cost_reporting.statistical_limits: Three repetitions per task/route are exploratory; median/min/max and raw rows only, no p95 or broad-domain improvement claim.
